FileChanged.reason: The FileChanged registration never fired once between v2.1.1 and v2.1.33, for three independent reasons confirmed against a real Claude Code runtime: (1) it declared `if: "Write|Edit(docs/**/*.md)"`, but `if` holds exactly one permission rule and does not accept `|` alternation — the same string suppressed the hook on a valid tool event too, isolating syntax as its own cause; (2) `if` is evaluated only on PreToolUse/PostToolUse/PostToolUseFailure/PermissionRequest/PermissionDenied, and a hook declaring `if` on any other event never runs; (3) FileChanged's matcher names literal files to watch on disk (letters, digits, `_`, `|`), so the path glob this handler needs is not expressible on that event at all. Cause (3) means the handler's purpose — reacting to Claude editing a PDCA document — can never be served by FileChanged regardless of the other two faults, so the capability moved to the event that actually describes it rather than staying registered and dead.

qa-phase.reason: Removed context:fork so qa-phase runs in the main session context. AskUserQuestion is stripped at the fork sub-agent boundary (CC #34592 / #54892) and cannot work in a forked skill; the PRE-SCAN continue/abort gate requires it.
